_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::mixture#2. The idea is right — growth needs a time-dependent mass source — but RHO_GROWTH is not a 4C key and growth is not a switch on the steady rule. On upstream mixture_growth_full_constrained_mixture_fiber_non_adaptive.4C.yaml the driver is GROWTH_CONSTANT on MIX_Constituent_FullConstrainedMixtureFiber under MIX_GrowthRemodelMixtureRule: zeroing it moves 20 of the 28 result tests. Adding RHO_GROWTH to that rule is a parse abort ('Could not match this input', global_data/4C_global_data_read.cpp), and so is adding GROWTH_STRATEGY to MIX_Rule_Simple on the steady deck mixture_elast_hyper_dynamic.4C.yaml — the steady rule has no growth slot at all, so 'a steady mixture solve cannot capture growth' is enforced by the input spec rather than surfacing as a silent pure-elastic answer. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the NOGROWTH arm: leave GROWTH_CONSTANT alone. Nothing then shows that it drives the growth — EXIT_NOGROWTH becomes 0, the failure count goes to zero and no failure line prints — so the fixture must go red.

remove the pathology from the SIMPLEGROW arm: do not attach a growth strategy to the steady rule. EXIT_SIMPLEGROW becomes 0 and SIMPLE_RULE_ACCEPTS_GROWTH_STRATEGY becomes 1, so the fixture must go red.
